basic_details.job_title: UPMRC Chief Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited (UPMRC) has 2 posts of Chief Engineer (Civil) for Lucknow/Kanpur/Agra, to be filled on deputation basis from experienced officers of the Civil Department working in Government organisations, Public Sector Undertakings and Government Metro Companies. The application, in the enclosed form and forwarded through proper channel, goes to the Manager/HR, UPMRC, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow, and must be submitted before the closing date, 16 December 2026; applications received after the closing date and time will not be entertained.

age_limit.details: Max. 57 years, as on the last date of vacancy notification. The cut-off date for age and eligibility criteria is the closing date of the vacancy notice (16/12/2026). The notice lists no age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: About UPMRC
content_sections.text: Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Ltd is a 50:50 jointly owned company of the Government of India and the Government of Uttar Pradesh, with its Administrative Building at Vipin Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow. It is responsible for implementing and operating the Metro in various cities of Uttar Pradesh. The notice states that Metro is operational in Lucknow, Kanpur and Agra (priority corridor), works on the balance corridors of Kanpur and Agra are in progress, and the Union Cabinet has recently approved an 11.2 kilometre East-West Corridor under Phase 1B of the Lucknow Metro project.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application must be made in the prescribed proforma enclosed with the notice ("Prescribed Proforma for Submission of Application on Deputation Basis") and sent to this address: Manager/HR, Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited, Administrative Building, Near Ambedkar Samajik Parivatan Sthal, Vipin Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow - 226010 Fill in the enclosed application form, including the Vacancy Notice No., File No., the post applied for and choice of station (wherever applicable) – the form asks that these boxes not be left blank. Submit the application through proper channel, requesting the parent organisation to forward it along with NOC, D&AR and Vigilance Clearance, and APAR ratings for the preceding 04 years. Get the "Certificate by the Employer" in the form signed and stamped by the employer, verifying the details at S. No. 1 to 27 against service records. Send the application so that it is with UPMRC before the closing date, 16/12/2026. An advance copy of the application with all supporting documents may be sent to [email protected] ; sending the hard copy of the application is mandatory. The notice does not mention a particular postal mode or anything to be written on the envelope. UPMRC will not be responsible for any postal delay, wrong delivery or non-delivery.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: There is one post, Chief Engineer (Civil), with 02 (Two) vacancies for Lucknow/Kanpur/Agra. Applications are invited from experienced persons of Indian Nationality of the Civil Department working in various Government organisations, Public Sector Undertakings and Government Metro Companies, having relevant experience. Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Degree in Civil Engineering from Govt. recognized University/ Institute. Candidates must meet one of the following: (i) CDA pay scale: Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in SAG pay scale of Rs 1,44,200-2,18,200/- (Revised/Level-14)/Rs. 37,400-67,000/- + Grade Pay Rs. 10,000/- (Pre-revised) or higher, with a total of 17 years of post-qualification work experience at Group-A Gazetted/Executive Level, including services put in on deputation. OR Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in Selection Grade pay scale of Rs. 1,23,100-2,15,900/- (Revised/Level-13)/Rs. 37,400-67,000/- + Grade Pay Rs. 8,700/- (Pre-revised) or higher for at least 03 years, with a total of 17 years of post-qualification work experience at Group-A Gazetted/Executive Level, including services put in on deputation. (ii) IDA pay scale: Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in IDA pay scale of Rs.1,20,000-2,80,000 (Revised)/Rs.51300-73000/- (Pre-revised) or higher, with a total of 17 years of post-qualification work experience at Group-A Gazetted/Executive Level, including services put in on deputation. OR Executives/Officers either working or empanelled in IDA pay scale of Rs. 90,000-2,40,000/- (Revised)/Rs. 36,600-62,000/- (Pre-Revised) or higher for at least 03 years, with a total of 17 years of post-qualification work experience at Group-A Gazetted/Executive Level, including services put in on deputation. The experience should be with Railway/Railway CPSEs/PSUs/Government Metro Companies/other Central/State Govt. undertakings or their instrumentalities. The candidate must be familiar with varied experience of working in the field of installation & commissioning / maintenance of Metro/Railway track. Varied experience of working in civil engineering and conversance with working in a computerised environment. Hands on knowledge of various computer applications relating to the job is desirable. Max. 57 years, as on the last date of vacancy notification. The cut-off date for age and eligibility criteria is the closing date of the vacancy notice (16/12/2026). The notice lists no age relaxation. The scale of pay is parent pay plus deputation allowance on deputation basis. The term of appointment is deputation, with a normal tenure of 3 years, which may be extendable. Other conditions: the candidate should be free from D&AR/Vigilance, and should be fit in the related field as well as physically and medically fit. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Checklist of documents to be enclosed, as printed in the application form: Educational Certificates (Matric / Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Degree in Civil Engineering from Govt. recognized University/ Institute) Work Experience Certificate NOC from present Employer Vigilance and D&AR Clearance from present Employer APARs of the Last 04 years The form also asks for supporting documents with the educational qualifications, experience details, previous deputation/foreign assignment, APAR ratings and awards, a detailed note with supporting documents for the essential and desirable experience and the pay-scale criteria, and separate sheets for any conviction, penalty or pending case. It also asks whether the applicant is debarred from deputation, has completed the cooling off period, has applied under the Central Staffing Scheme (with the registration number allotted by supremo.gov.in, if any), and has appeared for an interview in UPMRC in the past.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in UPMRC Chief Engineer (Civil) Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 02 (Two) posts of Chief Engineer (Civil) for Lucknow/Kanpur/Agra, to be filled on deputation basis; the vacancies are provisional and subject to increase or decrease.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for UPMRC Chief Engineer (Civil)?
faq.answer: The closing date is 16 December 2026, which is 30 days from the date of notification of vacancy; applications received after the closing date and time will not be entertained.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for UPMRC Chief Engineer (Civil)?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree or Equivalent Degree in Civil Engineering from a Govt. recognized University/Institute, along with 17 years of post-qualification experience at Group-A Gazetted/Executive Level in the specified CDA or IDA pay scales.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for UPMRC Chief Engineer (Civil)?
faq.answer: The age limit is Max. 57 years as on the last date of vacancy notification, which is the closing date, 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What pay will a UPMRC Chief Engineer (Civil) on deputation get?
faq.answer: The scale of pay is parent pay plus deputation allowance on deputation basis.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for UPMRC Chief Engineer (Civil)?
faq.answer: Submit the enclosed application form through proper channel, forwarded by your parent organisation with NOC, D&AR and Vigilance Clearance and APARs of the preceding 04 years, to Manager/HR, Uttar Pradesh Metro Rail Corporation Limited, Administrative Building, Near Ambedkar Samajik Parivatan Sthal, Vipin Khand, Gomti Nagar, Lucknow - 226010.

faq.question: Q7. Can I apply for UPMRC Chief Engineer (Civil) by email only?
faq.answer: No. An advance copy with supporting documents may be sent to [email protected], but sending the hard copy of the application is mandatory.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for UPMRC Chief Engineer (Civil)?
faq.answer: Selection is based on an interview at Lucknow, and UPMRC reserves the right to shortlist candidates for the interview; the NOC must be submitted before the interview to take part.

faq.question: Q9. How long is the deputation tenure at UPMRC?
faq.answer: The normal tenure of deputation is 3 years, which may be extendable.

faq.question: Q10. Is travelling allowance paid for the UPMRC interview?
faq.answer: No. Candidates called for interview shall not be paid any travelling allowance by UPMRC for attending the interview.
